title: Order API 5xx under an unprecedented traffic peak
description: A marketing campaign drove the order API to 940 rps, more than twice the highest peak it had ever served. The service saturates and returns 500s, and its database connections start timing out under the queue depth. The logs are therefore dominated by database connection errors — but the pool never saturates, the database stays up, and nothing was reconfigured. The database errors are a consequence of the load, not its cause.
